blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines and Japan have agreed to work toward the transfer of the first Abukuma-class warship to the Philippine Navy as soon as possible after its decommissioning, as the two countries expand defense cooperation. Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. and Japanese Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi reached the understanding during their bilateral meeting in Cebu on Wednesday, on the sidelines of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) defense meetings, according to a joint statement released by the Department of National Defense (DND).
